Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner asserted that Wikipedia listed Hans J. Salter’s death place as Vienna based only on a search-result snippet, without opening and verifying the actual article. This misinterpretation introduced a false conflict; authoritative sources (LA Times and Wikipedia itself) indicate he died in Studio City, California.
